manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Werefox Bodyguard, and Faceless Butcher must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Faceless Butcher for its mana cost.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles Werefox Bodyguard until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, Werefox Bodyguard is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Werefox Bodyguard enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Werefox Bodyguard leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Werefox Bodyguard's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
